Custom Values

Custom values are like personalized settings that you can adjust to make your experience with our snapshot uniquely yours. They give you the power to tailor how the snapshot behaves, ensuring it fits your needs perfectly. Whether it's tweaking configurations or fine-tuning outputs, custom values empower you to make the snapshot work just the way you want it to.

If you go to Settings, then Custom Values, you will see the values we have for you. For each value, you can simply click the three dots on the side of each section to add your own value to the custom values.

Whatever you add to these values will update the entire snapshot with that information, whether it pertains to your website, funnels, automations, emails, and more.

Landscaper Snapshot Custom Values

In our landscaper snapshot, we provide customizable values tailored to optimize your landscaping business's operations and marketing efforts. These custom values allow you to streamline processes, enhance client satisfaction, and drive business growth effectively.

52-Week Nurture Campaign Landing Page URL

This value represents the URL of the landing page for your 52-week nurture campaign. It directs potential clients to a dedicated page where they can learn about your landscaping services, sign up for your nurture campaign, and receive valuable content over the course of a year.

Google Review Link (Google Review Campaign)

This link will be the landscaping google review link that will be used for a google review campaign. Positive reviews contribute to your online reputation and help attract new clients to your business.

Google Review Link (Continuous Reputation Management)⭐

Similar to the previous value, this link will be the same as above and it will prompt clients to leave a review after receiving landscaping services. It may lead to a review platform other than Google, offering clients flexibility in where they leave feedback.

Client Consultation Calendar Link

This value provides clients with a direct link to your consultation calendar, allowing them to schedule appointments for landscaping consultations. It simplifies the booking process and ensures efficient time management for both you and your clients.

DR Campaign Offer

The DR campaign offer is a customizable value that serves as an incentive for potential clients to engage with your landscaping services. It may include discounts, promotions, or special packages designed to attract new clients and drive conversions.

Funnel Offer

The funnel offer is a customized value specific to your marketing funnels. It represents the incentive or offer presented to potential clients as they progress through your marketing funnel stages, such as lead generation or conversion.

Holiday Email Offer

This value represents a special offer or promotion tailored for holiday seasons. It allows you to capitalize on seasonal trends and festivities to attract new clients or encourage repeat business from existing clients.

Referral Campaign Offer

The referral campaign offer incentivizes clients to refer your landscaping services to others by offering rewards, discounts, or other incentives for successful referrals. It encourages word-of-mouth marketing and helps expand your client base.

Service Area

This value specifies the geographical area where your landscaping services are available. It helps potential clients determine if your services are accessible to them and ensures accurate communication regarding service availability.

These custom values empower you to customize and optimize various aspects of your landscaping business, from marketing campaigns to client interactions, ultimately driving success and growth in the landscaping industry.

2. Pipelines

Understanding Sales Pipelines

A sales pipeline is a visual representation of the stages a prospect goes through during the sales process, from initial contact to closing the deal. It helps businesses track and manage their sales activities, allowing them to identify bottlenecks, prioritize leads, and optimize their sales efforts effectively.

Snapshot Pipelines

In our snapshot, you'll find three distinct pipelines tailored to streamline your sales processes:

DR Campaign Pipeline: This pipeline is designed specifically for managing leads generated from your DR campaigns. It helps you track and nurture these leads through the various stages of the sales cycle until they convert into customers.

Review Campaign Pipeline:The review campaign pipeline allows you to see all of your review requests that were sent through your review campaign, allowing you to see how many left a review versus those who didn't.

Main landscaping Leads Pipeline: The main landscaping leads pipeline serves as the central hub for managing all your landscaping-related leads. Whether they come from website forms, web chats, or other sources, this pipeline enables you to organize, track, and prioritize these leads effectively to maximize conversion opportunities.

With these three automated pipelines at your disposal, you can efficiently manage your sales activities, nurture leads, and drive revenue growth for your landscaping business.

3. Calendars

Automated calendars are indispensable tools that revolutionize scheduling processes, enhance organization, and boost productivity for landscaping businesses. They automate appointment booking, service scheduling, and activity coordination, enabling efficient resource allocation and exceptional service delivery to clients.

Snapshot Automated Calendars

In our landscaping snapshot, you'll discover two specialized automated calendars tailored to simplify scheduling and streamline client interactions:

Client Consultations Calendar

The Client Consultations Calendar is dedicated to managing appointments for client consultations and site visits. It provides a seamless scheduling experience for potential clients interested in landscaping services. Key features include:

Easy Appointment Booking: Clients can easily schedule consultations by selecting available time slots on the calendar.

Automated Notifications: Clients receive automated reminders about their scheduled consultations, reducing the likelihood of no-shows.

Integration with Sales Pipeline: Appointments booked through this calendar automatically update the landscaping sales pipeline, facilitating lead management and nurturing processes.

Benefits:

Streamlined Scheduling: Simplifies the process of booking client consultations, improving efficiency and client satisfaction.

Enhanced Lead Management: Integrates seamlessly with the sales pipeline, enabling effective lead nurturing and conversion.

Landscaping Maintenance Calendar

The Landscaping Maintenance Calendar is designed to manage maintenance and service appointments for ongoing landscaping projects. It ensures timely execution of routine maintenance tasks, service calls, and landscaping projects. Key features include:

Scheduled Maintenance Tasks: Allows scheduling of routine maintenance tasks such as lawn mowing, trimming, fertilization, and irrigation checks.

Service Call Management: Facilitates scheduling of service calls for landscaping repairs or emergencies.

Efficient Resource Allocation: Optimizes resource allocation by assigning tasks to available team members based on their schedules and expertise.

Benefits:

Timely Service Delivery: Ensures timely execution of maintenance tasks and service calls, enhancing client satisfaction.

Improved Resource Management: Optimizes resource allocation and scheduling, maximizing operational efficiency and productivity.

Appointment Confirmation, Reminders, no-show, & Cancellation Automation

Understanding Appointment Automation

Automated appointment management systems streamline the process of scheduling, confirming, and managing appointments for businesses. By leveraging automation, businesses can enhance efficiency, improve customer communication, and reduce no-show rates, ultimately maximizing productivity and customer satisfaction.

Snapshot Appointment Automation

In the Landscaping snapshot, we offer comprehensive automation for appointment confirmation, reminders, no-shows, and cancellations. Here's how it works:

Appointment Confirmation: When someone books an appointment on either calendar, they will receive an automated confirmation email or text message, ensuring that their appointment is successfully scheduled and confirmed.

Appointment Reminders: Prior to the scheduled appointment, automated reminders will be sent to the customer to minimize the risk of no-shows and ensure that they are prepared and ready for their appointment.

No-show Management: In the event of a no-show, the system will automatically tag the customer accordingly, allowing you to follow up and reschedule as needed to minimize disruptions to your schedule and workflow.

Cancellation Handling: If a customer cancels their appointment, the system will update their status accordingly. For example, on the landscaper Consultation Calendar, if they book an appointment, they will be updated as "appointment booked" in the pipeline. If they cancel, their status will be updated to "canceled," and if they fail to show up for the appointment, they will be marked as "no show" in the pipeline.

6. Funnels

Funnels are strategic marketing frameworks designed to guide potential clients through a series of steps, ultimately leading them to take a specific action, such as booking an appointment or making a purchase. In our landscaping snapshot, we offer four specialized funnels tailored to attract, engage, and convert leads effectively.

$100 Off Services Funnel

The $100 Off Services Funnel incentivizes potential clients to book landscaping services by offering a significant discount. This funnel incorporates an opt-in survey followed by an appointment booking process. Key features include:

Opt-In Survey: Engages potential clients with a survey to gather information about their landscaping needs and preferences.

Custom Offer: Offers a $100 discount on landscaping services, enticing clients to take action and book an appointment.

Appointment Booking: Guides clients through the appointment booking process, making it seamless and convenient.

Benefits:

Lead Qualification: Gathers valuable information about potential clients' needs, enabling personalized service offerings.

Conversion Incentive: Provides a compelling offer to motivate clients to book landscaping services, driving conversions.

3 Step Funnel

The 3 Step Funnel offers a structured approach to engage potential clients through a series of steps, including video viewing, appointment scheduling, and a thank you page. Key features include:

Engaging Video: Captivates potential clients with a compelling video showcasing your landscaping services, expertise, and customer testimonials.

Calendar Page: Provides clients with easy access to your scheduling calendar, allowing them to book appointments conveniently.

Thank You Page: Expresses gratitude to clients for their interest and provides further information or resources.

Offer: This funnel comes with no offer therefore you can add your own off to this funnel using a custom value called “funnel offer”.

Benefits:

Visual Engagement: Uses video content to capture attention and showcase your landscaping offerings effectively.

Seamless Experience: Guides potential clients through the appointment scheduling process smoothly, enhancing user experience and satisfaction.

50% Off For First Time Customers Funnel

The 50% Off For First Time Customers Funnel targets new clients with a special offer of a 50% discount on landscaping services. This funnel incorporates an opt-in survey followed by a calendar page for appointment scheduling. Key features include:

Survey Opt-In: Encourages potential clients to provide information about their landscaping needs and preferences.

Custom Offer: Provides first-time customers with a 50% discount on landscaping services, incentivizing them to book an appointment.

Appointment Scheduling: Guides clients through the appointment booking process, making it easy and convenient.

Benefits:

New Client Acquisition: Attracts new clients by offering a generous discount on landscaping services, encouraging them to try your services.

Conversion Incentive: Provides a compelling offer to motivate first-time customers to schedule appointments, driving conversions.

Free Consultation Funnel

The Free Consultation Funnel offers potential clients a no-obligation consultation to discuss their landscaping needs. This two-step opt-in funnel gathers client information and schedules consultation appointments. Key features include:

Opt-In Form: Collects potential clients' contact information and details about their landscaping requirements.

Consultation Scheduling: Guides clients through the process of scheduling a free consultation appointment.

Confirmation Page: Confirms the successful scheduling of the consultation appointment and provides additional details or instructions.

Benefits:

Lead Generation: Collects contact information from potential clients interested in landscaping services, expanding your client base.

Relationship Building: Offers a personalized consultation experience, fostering trust and rapport with potential clients.

Funnel Automations:

Each funnel will be fully automated, with the name of each automation matching the corresponding funnel. Similarly, the funnel forms will be named identically for easy organization. When someone opts into a funnel, they will be seamlessly updated in the sales pipeline, tagged appropriately, and trigger an internal notification for you. Additionally, the lead will receive a personalized text and email with their offer upon opting in. If they proceed to book an appointment through the funnel, the appointment reminder automations will be triggered.

It's important to note that each automation and text message can be easily customized to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a cohesive and personalized experience for your leads.

7. 52 Week Nurture Campaigns

In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive 52-week email and text landscaping nurture campaigns designed to cultivate relationships with your leads and keep the landscaping business top-of-mind. Here's what you can expect:

52-Week Email Nurture Campaign: This campaign consists of a series of weekly emails delivered to your landscaping leads over the course of a year. Each email contains valuable tips, industry insights, and exclusive offers tailored to their needs and interests. The goal of this campaign is to keep your landscaping business front and center in the minds of your leads while providing them with ongoing value and engagement.

52-Week Text Nurture Campaign: Similarly, the 52-week text nurture campaign delivers weekly text messages to your landscaping leads, keeping them informed and engaged with your landscaping business. These texts may include quick tips, special promotions, or reminders about upcoming events or services. The goal is to maintain regular communication with your leads through a convenient and accessible channel, fostering a sense of connection and trust.

Benefits of Landscaping Nurture Campaigns

Long-Term Relationship Building: By delivering consistent value and engagement over an extended period, nurture campaigns help to build strong relationships with your leads, positioning the landscaping business as a trusted and reliable partner.

Increased Engagement: Regular communication through emails and text messages keeps the landscaping business top-of-mind and encourages ongoing interaction with your leads, increasing engagement and retention rates.

Customizable Content: You have the flexibility to customize the content of both the emails and text messages to align with your branding, messaging, and marketing objectives. Whether it's sharing educational content, promoting special offers, or inviting leads to events, you can tailor the campaigns to suit your unique business needs.

With our 52-week email and text landscaping nurture campaigns, you can stay connected with your leads, provide them with valuable insights and offers, and nurture them towards conversion over the long term.

8. Database Reactivation

Understanding Database Reactivation Campaigns

Database reactivation campaigns are strategic marketing initiatives aimed at re-engaging with inactive or lapsed leads in your database. These campaigns help revitalize your contact list, rekindle interest in your products or services, and ultimately drive conversions. In our snapshot, we offer two types of database reactivation campaigns: a basic version and an advanced version, each offering unique features and functionalities.

Snapshot Database Reactivation Campaigns

Basic Database Reactivation Campaign: The basic campaign provides a straightforward approach to reactivating dormant leads in your database. You have the flexibility to customize the offer for this campaign using a custom value. This campaign aims to reconnect with inactive leads, remind them of your value proposition, and encourage them to re-engage with your business.

Advanced Database Reactivation Campaign (DR Campaign): The advanced campaign takes database reactivation to the next level by incorporating dynamic lead management features. Similar to the basic campaign, you can customize the offer using a custom value. However, this campaign goes a step further by updating leads in a dedicated DR campaign pipeline. If a lead responds positively to the campaign, they will be moved to a "responded" status in the pipeline, indicating active interest. Conversely, if they indicate disinterest, they will be moved to a "not interested" status, allowing you to focus your efforts on more promising leads.

10. Referral Campaign Workflow

Referral campaigns are powerful marketing strategies designed to leverage the existing customer base to acquire new customers. By incentivizing customers to refer friends, family, or colleagues to your business, referral campaigns can rapidly expand your customer network and drive growth. In our snapshot, we offer a comprehensive referral campaign feature that enables you to easily create and manage referral programs tailored to your business needs.

Snapshot Referral Campaign

Customizable Referral Incentives: Our referral campaign feature allows you to customize the incentives offered to customers for referring new business. By utilizing custom values, you can tailor the incentives to align with your promotional strategies and budget. Whether it's offering discounts, freebies, or exclusive rewards, the referral campaign feature empowers you to create compelling incentives that motivate customers to spread the word about your business.

Benefits of Referral Campaigns

Expanded Customer Base: Referral campaigns tap into the power of word-of-mouth marketing to attract new customers. By leveraging the networks of your existing customers, you can rapidly expand your customer base and drive growth for your business.

Enhanced Trust and Credibility: Recommendations from friends or family members are highly trusted by consumers. By encouraging referrals, you can capitalize on this trust and credibility to attract high-quality leads and convert them into loyal customers.

Cost-Effective Marketing: Referral campaigns are a cost-effective way to acquire new customers compared to traditional advertising channels. Since referrals come from satisfied customers, the cost per acquisition is typically lower, resulting in a higher return on investment.

With our customizable referral campaign feature, you can harness the power of word-of-mouth marketing to drive growth and success for your business.

11. Incoming Lead Follow Up Workflows

Incoming lead follow-up workflows are automated processes designed to promptly respond to inquiries and messages from potential customers across various communication channels. These workflows ensure that every lead receives a timely and personalized response, increasing the chances of conversion and providing exceptional customer service. In our snapshot, we offer four incoming lead follow-up workflows tailored to different communication channels: Google My Business (GMB) message, email, Facebook message, and Instagram direct message (DM).

Snapshot Incoming Lead Follow-Up Workflows

GMB Message Workflow: This workflow is triggered when someone sends a message through your Google My Business listing. The workflow automatically tags the lead, updates their status in the pipeline as responded to, and notifies the landscaping business. You can easily customize the messaging and actions of this workflow to suit your preferences and brand voice.

Email Workflow: The email workflow is activated when a lead reaches out via email. Similar to the GMB message workflow, it tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the landscaper ensuring a prompt and efficient response to email inquiries.

Facebook Message Workflow: When a potential customer sends a message to your Facebook page, the Facebook message workflow springs into action. It tags the lead, updates their status, and alerts the landscaper, enabling seamless communication and follow-up through Facebook Messenger.

Instagram DM Workflow: The Instagram DM workflow handles incoming direct messages on your Instagram account. It automatically tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the landscaper, facilitating quick and effective engagement with potential customers on Instagram.

With our incoming lead follow-up workflows, you can effectively manage inquiries and messages across multiple communication channels, providing timely and personalized responses to potential customers.

12. Reputation Management

Reputation management is crucial for maintaining a positive image and credibility for your landscaping business. It involves actively monitoring and influencing how your brand is perceived by customers, both online and offline. In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive reputation management features to help you proactively manage and enhance your online reputation.

Snapshot Reputation Management Features

Ongoing Reputation Management: After each service, customers have the option to request a review. This process allows you to gather feedback and testimonials from satisfied customers, helping to boost your online reputation and credibility.

Google Review Campaign: Our Google review campaign is designed to generate a significant number of new reviews for your landscaping business. You can input a list of existing customers into the campaign to kickstart the process, resulting in 30-100 new reviews right away. Customers in this campaign are managed through a dedicated review campaign pipeline, allowing you to track who has left a review and who hasn't.

Key Features and Customization Options

Custom Review Links: The review link for both ongoing reputation management and the Google review campaign can be customized using custom values. This allows you to tailor the review links to your branding and preferences.

Trigger Links: Each campaign includes two trigger links that serve as indicators of customer engagement. These trigger links, associated with the review custom value links, help you track whether customers have clicked on the review links or not, if clicked they will no longer get review reminders and so on.

13. Invoice Reminders, Cancellation, & Refunds

Automation for invoice management streamlines the process of handling invoices, reminders, cancellations, and refunds, ensuring smooth and efficient financial transactions for your landscaping business. These automated workflows help you stay organized, reduce administrative burden, and provide a seamless experience for your customers.

Snapshot Automation for Invoice Management

Invoice Reminders Automation: This automation sends timely reminders to customers who have outstanding invoices, prompting them to make payment. By automating invoice reminders, you can minimize late payments, improve cash flow, and maintain positive relationships with your customers.

Cancellation Automation: When a customer cancels a service or appointment, this automation ensures that the cancellation process is handled smoothly and efficiently. It updates the customer's status, triggers any necessary refunds, and notifies relevant stakeholders, allowing you to manage cancellations with ease and professionalism.

Refunds Automation: In cases where refunds are warranted, this automation handles the refund process seamlessly. It initiates the refund, updates the customer's status accordingly, and provides notifications to both the customer and your team, ensuring transparency and accountability in the refund process.

Key Features and Customization Options

Timely Notifications: Each automation sends timely notifications to customers and stakeholders, keeping them informed throughout the invoicing, cancellation, and refund processes.

Customizable Messaging: You have the flexibility to customize the messaging of each automation to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a consistent and professional experience for your customers.

14. Missed Call Text Back

The Missed Call Text Back Automation is a proactive response system designed to engage with potential leads who have attempted to contact your landscaping business but were unable to connect via phone. This automation sends a text message to the missed caller, providing them with an opportunity to book a consultation or appointment with your business. By leveraging this automation, you can effectively follow up with missed leads and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Snapshot Missed Call Text Back Automation

Engagement Text Message: When a call goes unanswered or is missed, the automation triggers a text message to be sent to the caller's phone number. The message is crafted to be engaging and inviting, encouraging the caller to consider booking a consultation or appointment with your landscaping business.

Call to Action: The text message includes a clear call to action, such as a link to your online booking system or a phone number to call back, making it easy for the recipient to take immediate action and schedule a consultation.

Personalization: To enhance engagement and relevance, the text message can be personalized with the caller's name or other relevant details, creating a more personalized and tailored experience for the recipient.
